conflicts.description: Early report of $36.5M; the later SEC filing gives $33.0M cash + $2.6M note.

transactions.verification_basis: Primary document reviewed: QuinStreet FY2011 10-K, MD&A 'Acquisitions in Fiscal Year 2011': "In July 2010, we acquired the website business Insurance.com from Insurance.com Group, Inc., ... in exchange for $33.0 million in cash and the issuance of a $2.6 million non-interest-bearing, unsecured promissory note". Verifies a website-business acquisition, not a domain-only sale.
transactions.rights_basis: U.S. SEC EDGAR filing. Facts are cited with attribution and a link; the filing text is not republished. EDGAR fair-access rules apply to any automated retrieval.
transactions.notes: Website-business acquisition, so not a domain-only comparable. The headline $35.6M is $33.0M cash plus a $2.6M note.
